mcqs.q: What does Labov's research show about language variation?
options: Language varies systematically by social class, gender, age and context — and speakers shift style depending on formality, often unconsciously.
Labov showed that working-class people speak ungrammatically.
Labov showed that everyone speaks the same way regardless of background.
Chomsky said children should be taught grammar from age two.
